note: M6 pins exactly one Take vocabulary source (plan Task 4). The vendored source is the unmodified pinned donor file; the Node parity harness verifies source_sha256 before executing it and runs the shared fixture corpus through both the pinned TS source and the Python v2 vocabulary. The harness is test-only: never shipped, imported, or started by the ArcReel runtime.

import_resolution_dependency.note: enums.ts has no imports at all (self-contained module-level `as const` arrays); needs no @/ path resolution and no other vendored file.

take_shot_vocabulary.excluded_reason: Lifecycle (SHOT_STATUSES), rendered-asset (ASPECT_RATIOS) and provenance (ANALYSIS_SOURCES) vocabularies are out of scope for M6's ShotSpecV2 (plan Fixed Implementation Contract: "lifecycle/provider/rendered-asset enums are excluded").
take_shot_vocabulary.parity_coverage_notes: Pure string-literal const arrays, no regex/locale/Unicode parity concerns unlike the M5C ports. Parity is exact set-and-order equality between each TS array and its Python StrEnum's member order, plus per-case validity checks for known-invalid and compound-string candidates. No residual divergence.
